hypotheses.justification: Split into nonempty and empty cases for ι. The nonempty case uses the existing proof. If ι is empty, EuclideanSpace ℝ ι is subsingleton, so every K is subsingleton. Choose α = 1 and C = 0; Set.Subsingleton.holderOnWith proves the conclusion for any function, including preciseRepresentative regardless of its junk values. This also covers empty K.
